news.headline: Wall Street slides: S&P 500 -2.0%, Nasdaq -2.25% on AI/tech jitters
news.what_happened: US equities sold off sharply in the latest session, extending a tech-led decline that began earlier in November.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off global tone raises odds of FII caution and weighs on Indian IT via Nasdaq valuations; defensives like pharma and FMCG tend to hold better.

news.headline: Gold -4.1% and silver -6.2% in sharp precious-metals selloff
news.what_happened: Gold fell to about $3,535/oz and silver to about $41.6/oz.
news.why_it_matters: Lower gold values reduce collateral value for gold-loan NBFCs; short-term pressure on Muthoot/Manappuram.

news.headline: Asia sells off: Nikkei -4.3%, Hang Seng -1.9%
news.what_happened: Japan and Hong Kong fell sharply following the US decline.
news.why_it_matters: Broad Asian risk-off points to a soft start for Indian benchmarks; Nifty closed +0.5% at 25,514 previously, so some giveback is possible.

news.headline: FIIs remain net buyers in November; crude steady near $83
news.what_happened: Latest confirmed FII cash data (16 Nov) showed net buying of about Rs 4,865 Cr; November FII inflows are heavy. WTI +0.4%, Brent about $89.8.
news.why_it_matters: Strong FII support has underpinned Nifty near highs, but a global risk-off could reverse flows. Steady crude is neutral for OMCs and airlines.
